rule dac_gh_0029 {
  meta:
    author = "Detection Engineer"
    description = "GitHub: Repository secret or environment secret created outside CI bot - repository_secret.create by human admin"
    severity = "Medium"
    rule_id = "DAC-GH-0029"
    source_language = "spl"
    converted_by = "rulebridge"
    mitre_attack_technique = "T1552.001"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "GITHUB"
    ($e.metadata.product_event_type = "repository_secret.create" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "environment_secret.create" nocase or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "org_secret.create" nocase)

  condition:
    $e
}
